title: Implement repo.py — repo resolution and cloning
description: Implement D:\GitHub\agent-foundry\chat_repo\src\chat_repo\repo.py. Define the RepoInfo dataclass (owner, name, clone_url, local_path: Path, is_local: bool, is_shallow: bool). Implement resolve_repo(source: str, full: bool = False) -> RepoInfo. Handle three input forms: (1) GitHub URL https://github.com/owner/name — parse owner/name; (2) short form owner/name matching regex r'^[\w.-]+/[\w.-]+$'; (3) local path (relative, absolute, or '.') — resolve to absolute Path, read git remote get-url origin to derive owner/name (fall back to directory name if no remote). Clone destination: ~/.chat-repo/repos/<owner>/<name>. Shallow clone (--depth 1) by default; full clone when full=True. Idempotent: if destination exists, run git fetch --all. All subprocess calls use cwd appropriately. Implement path_is_safe(path: str | Path, root: Path) -> bool that resolves symlinks and returns True only if path is within root (use Path.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())). All functions have full type hints. Run 'uv run ruff format .' and 'uv run ruff check .' and 'uv run pyrefly check' after implementation.
acceptance_criteria: resolve_repo('https://github.com/owner/name') returns RepoInfo with owner='owner', name='name'
resolve_repo('owner/name') returns correct RepoInfo
resolve_repo('.') or local path returns RepoInfo with is_local=True
path_is_safe('../etc/passwd', repo_root) returns False
path_is_safe(repo_root / 'src/foo.py', repo_root) returns True
Idempotent: calling resolve_repo twice on same GitHub repo runs git fetch instead of re-cloning
All type hints present; pyrefly check passes with zero errors
ruff format --check and ruff check pass with zero warnings

title: Implement tools/git.py — git @tool functions
description: Implement D:\GitHub\agent-foundry\chat_repo\src\chat_repo\tools\git.py. Import 'tool' and 'create_sdk_mcp_server' from claude_agent_sdk. Define four factory functions that accept repo_root: Path and return async @tool-decorated functions: (1) make_git_log(repo_root) returning git_log tool: @tool('git_log', 'Return last N commits with SHA, author, date, message', {'n': int, 'branch': str | None}), runs 'git log --format=%H|%an|%ae|%ad|%s -n {n} [{branch}]' via subprocess.run(cwd=repo_root); (2) make_git_show(repo_root) returning git_show tool: @tool('git_show', 'Return full diff and metadata for a commit SHA', {'sha': str}), runs 'git show {sha}'; (3) make_git_blame(repo_root) returning git_blame tool: @tool('git_blame', 'Return blame output for a file or line range', {'path': str, 'start_line': int | None, 'end_line': int | None}), runs 'git blame [-L start,end] {path}'; (4) make_contributors(repo_root) returning contributors tool: @tool('contributors', 'Return top N contributors by commit count', {'n': int}), runs 'git shortlog -sne --all'. All subprocess errors caught and returned as {'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Error: ...'}], 'is_error': True}. Define build_git_server(repo_root: Path) -> object that calls create_sdk_mcp_server(name='git', version='1.0.0', tools=[git_log, git_show, git_blame, contributors]). All tool functions are async and return dict[str, Any]. Full type hints. Run ruff and pyrefly after implementation.

title: Implement tools/github.py — GitHub REST API @tool functions
description: Implement D:\GitHub\agent-foundry\chat_repo\src\chat_repo\tools\github.py. Import 'tool' and 'create_sdk_mcp_server' from claude_agent_sdk, import httpx. Define factory functions that close over owner: str, name: str and return async @tool-decorated functions: (1) make_repo_meta(owner, name) → repo_meta tool: @tool('repo_meta', 'Return GitHub repository metadata', {}), GET /repos/{owner}/{name}; (2) make_list_prs(owner, name) → list_prs: @tool('list_prs', 'List latest N pull requests', {'state': str, 'n': int}), GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls?state={state}&per_page={n}; (3) make_get_pr(owner, name) → get_pr: @tool('get_pr', 'Get full PR details', {'number': int}), GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/pulls/{number}; (4) make_list_issues(owner, name) → list_issues: @tool('list_issues', 'List issues', {'state': str, 'label': str | None, 'n': int}); (5) make_list_releases(owner, name) → list_releases: @tool('list_releases', 'List latest N releases', {'n': int}), GET /repos/{owner}/{name}/releases?per_page={n}. All functions check os.environ.get('GITHUB_TOKEN') first — if absent return {'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'GitHub tools unavailable: set GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable.'}]}. Use httpx.Client with headers {'User-Agent': 'chat-repo/0.1', 'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'}. Catch httpx.HTTPStatusError and return {'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': f'GitHub API error {status}: {message}'}], 'is_error': True}. Define build_github_server(owner: str, name: str) -> object via create_sdk_mcp_server(name='github', version='1.0.0', tools=[...]). Full type hints. Run ruff and pyrefly.

title: Implement cli.py — REPL, slash commands, streaming, and entry point
description: Implement D:\GitHub\agent-foundry\chat_repo\src\chat_repo\cli.py. Use click for the CLI: @click.command(), @click.argument('repo'), @click.option('--full', is_flag=True), @click.option('--resume', 'resume_session', is_flag=True), @click.option('--model', default='claude-sonnet-4-5'). In the main function: (1) Check os.environ.get('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY') — if absent print error and sys.exit(1); (2) Call resolve_repo(repo, full=full) from repo.py; (3) Create or load session via session.py based on --resume flag; (4) Print startup banner using rich: repo name, clone path, session ID, model; (5) Run async REPL via asyncio.run(repl(...)). Implement async def repl(repo_info, state, model): build ClaudeAgentOptions; open 'async with ClaudeSDKClient(options) as client'; loop reading user input via asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, input, prompt_str); handle slash commands locally (never send to model): /help, /exit, /clear, /repo, /save <path>, /cost; for non-slash input: append user turn, call await client.query(text), then iterate 'async for msg in client.receive_response()' inside try/except KeyboardInterrupt — on interrupt cancel current receive, print cancellation notice, continue REPL; use Rich Live to stream TextBlock content token-by-token; on ResultMessage: store session_id to state.sdk_session_id, accumulate tokens and cost; append assistant turn to session after full response. /clear resets the client by breaking out of the async with block and re-entering it. /repo prints repo metadata read from git (owner, name, url, clone path, shallow/full, latest SHA, file count via Glob). /cost prints cumulative tokens and estimated cost. Full type hints. Run ruff and pyrefly.

All six slash commands are handled locally without calling the model
